Description: WARNING! Experimental feature! Use at your own risk! Resets throttle position learned value.
InnerDescription:
Apply brake before starting.
On some vehicles, after reseting ECM/PCM the idle speed will decrease or become unstable until ECM/PCM learns the correct value.
If you allow the engine to run at idle for 10 minutes at normal operating temperatures, IAC learning will occur.
